name: keep-your-prompts
description: Search, reuse, save and version your prompts and agent skills in Keep Your Prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Find, reuse and version your prompts
interface.longDescription: Keep Your Prompts is a versioned library for your prompts, system prompts and agent skills. Search your library by meaning, open a prompt with its variables filled in, save a prompt you just wrote as a new prompt or a new version, compare versions, and sort the prompts captured in your inbox. Keep Your Prompts only accesses the workspace you connect.
defaultPrompt: Find my prompt for writing release notes.
Save the prompt I just wrote as a new version.
What changed between version 3 and 4 of my support reply prompt?

positive.prompt: Find my prompt for replying to refund requests.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching prompts from the test workspace, with support/refund-reply first, showing handle, name, version and a snippet.

positive.prompt: Use my refund reply prompt for a customer named Dana whose order arrived damaged.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens support/refund-reply, fills the customer_name and issue variables, and writes the reply using the rendered prompt.

positive.prompt: Save this as a prompt called 'Weekly status email': Summarize this week's progress for {{team}} in five bullets, then list blockers.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for a similar prompt, then creates 'Weekly status email' with the team variable and reports its handle and version 1.

positive.prompt: What changed between version 1 and version 2 of my release notes prompt?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the word-level changes between the two versions of writing/release-notes and names any variables that were added or removed.

positive.prompt: Show me the prompts in my inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the captured prompts in the test workspace inbox with their source and first line, without changing them.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?
Delete every prompt in my library.
Show me the prompts in my coworker's private workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read, save and version prompts, compare versions and review the inbox.
